builtins.cat: print files of the open model, or what is piped in, control bytes shown as text
builtins.kappa: print the BLAKE3 label of a file of the open model, or of what is piped in
builtins.pwd: print the folder paths start from
builtins.save: keep this session's transcript in this browser, under a name
builtins.grep: print the lines that hold a pattern
builtins.head: print the first lines
builtins.uniq: drop a line that repeats the one before
builtins.diff: print the lines in which two files differ
builtins.cd: change the folder paths start from
builtins.append: add what is piped in to the end of a file of the model
builtins.mv: rename a file of the model
builtins.cp: copy a file of the model
builtins.write: write what is piped in to a file of the model, replacing it
builtins.touch: make an empty file in the model
builtins.rm: remove a file from the model

programs.check: lexlean check: LexLean's front end, as WebAssembly
programs.prove: Lean's kernel on the model's guarantees
programs.audit: the audit view's statuses, from the kernel and the vectors
